sentence: The mirror image holds too: when AI services fail, small firms lose more market value than large ones, and accuracy failures cost the most
passage: [Song et al. (2025), p. 504] "First, AI service failure events have a negative impact on the firm value. Second, small firms experience more share price declines due to AI service failure events than large firms." / "there are order effects on firm value across the service failure event types: accuracy $>$ safety $>$ privacy $>$ fairness."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly confirms that small firms suffer larger share price declines and that accuracy failures have the greatest impact on firm value.
